thesis: The episode introduces the story of IKEA, an 81-year-old company that sells over a billion Swedish meatballs a year and operates as the world's largest furniture retailer. The hosts examine how the company's founder, Ingvar Kamprad, grew up in the rural province of Småland, Sweden, where his family struggled financially after immigrating from Germany and facing the death of his grandfather.
